title: ruta chalepensis subsp. latifolia
intro: Ruta chalepensis subsp. latifolia, commonly known as a perennial herb, is a subspecies of the Rue plant. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ruta chalepensis subsp. latifolia include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the body from damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
